packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.name: Anthropic connection
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.description: Talks to Anthropic's models, keeping the fixed part of each request cached.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.name: Model connection base
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.description: The shared behaviour every AI model connection builds on, including how a failed or cut-off reply is handled.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.name: Custom model endpoint
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.description: Talks to any OpenAI-compatible model the owner adds by its address, which is checked first.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.name: Scripted model (test)
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.description: A test-only model that replays a script; never part of production.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.name: OpenAI-style connection
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.description: The shared connection for DeepSeek, Z.ai, OpenRouter and the owner's own endpoint, which speak OpenAI's older chat format.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.name: OpenAI connection
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/mo.description: Talks to OpenAI's models through the Responses API, and can shape each request the way the ChatGPT plan requires.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/re.name: Channel registry
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/re.description: Lists the outbound channels available, such as Telegram and webhooks.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/st.name: Storage package
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/st.description: Marks the secret-storage connections as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/st.name: Broker secrets store
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/st.description: Keeps the broker token and account passwords, encrypted.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/st.name: Encrypted secret store
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/st.description: Keeps the owner's secrets of every other kind, encrypted.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/vo.name: Voice adapters package
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/vo.description: Marks the voice connections as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/vo.name: Scripted speech (test)
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/vo.description: A test-only speech service that replays fixed text and audio.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/vo.name: Live voice negotiation
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/vo.description: Sets up a live voice session with OpenAI's Live API.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/vo.name: Speech to text
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/vo.description: Turns spoken audio into text with OpenAI.

packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/vo.name: Text to speech
packages/adapters/src/lonora_adapters/vo.description: Turns text into spoken audio with OpenAI.
